title: Orbs appearing inside Bledsoe's house

tellings.quote: just about every day of my life. and it comes in my house. Orbs appearing in my room over my chairs and flying through the house and stuff.

plain: Since about 2007, glowing balls of light, or orbs, are said to have shown up "just about every day" inside a family home in North Carolina, hovering over chairs and flying through the rooms. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs and whose experiences have drawn interest from NASA, tells this about his own house. If true, it would mean the phenomenon follows one person into his everyday life.
